rectify.title: Birth-Time Rectification

rectify.experimental: Experimental heuristic — birth-time rectification is a suggestion to verify against known life events, not an authoritative correction. Where the recorded time is reliable, trust it first.

methodDesc.nakshatra: Checks the Moon's birth star against the star expected from the exact birth moment, and nudges the time (±30 min) so they agree. Needs no extra input.
methodDesc.lagna: Checks the rising sign (Lagna) against the Moon and Maandi in the Rasi and Navamsa, nudging the time so the Lagna sits in a supportive relationship.
methodDesc.janma: Checks the classical birth-time gender indication and nudges the time so it agrees with the stated gender. Requires selecting a gender.

sensitive.title: Sensitive Points
sensitive.subtitle: Sphutas, Sahams & Argala
sensitive.intro: Sensitive points are supporting longitudes that fine-tune a reading — they colour and confirm the main chart rather than override it.
sensitive.calcError: Could not compute the sensitive points.
sensitive.sphutaNote: Sensitive longitudes derived from the natal chart (longevity, vitality and progeny helpers).
sensitive.sahamNote: 36 Arabic-part-like sensitive points, each tied to a life theme.
sensitive.argalaNote: Which houses receive strong planetary intervention (argala) versus obstruction (virodhargala).
sensitive.argalaEmpty: No strong argala or virodhargala stands out in this chart.
sensitive.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of these sensitive points using the model picked in Ask AI Astrologer.
sensitive.disclaimer: Sensitive points are supportive nuances for reflection, not standalone predictions.

muhurta.title: Muhurta
muhurta.subtitle: Auspicious timing (electional astrology)
muhurta.intro: Pick an activity and a date range to find the most auspicious windows, drawn from the panchanga and planetary hours.
muhurta.noWindows: No clearly auspicious window was found in this range. Try widening the dates.
muhurta.aiHint: Get a plain-language explanation of the best window and why.
muhurta.disclaimer: Muhurta is a traditional aid to timing — personal readiness matters too. Not medical, legal or financial advice.

subtools.title: Day tools
subtools.intro: Panchaka, Choghadiya and — with your profile — Tarabala & Chandrabala for a chosen day.
subtools.tarabalaNote: From your birth star {{birth}} to today's {{today}}.
subtools.chandrabalaNote: Transit Moon in {{transit}}, counted from your natal Moon in {{birth}}.
subtools.note: Choghadiya: Amrit/Shubh/Labh are good, Char is neutral, Rog/Kaal/Udveg are best avoided.

prashna.title: Prashna
prashna.subtitle: Horary astrology — the chart of the moment
prashna.intro: In Prashna, a chart cast for the exact moment you ask a question answers it — no birth data needed. Type your question and cast.
prashna.placeholder: e.g. Will I get the job I interviewed for?
prashna.locationNote: Cast for right now, at your current location (with your permission) or your profile's place.
prashna.disclaimer: A Prashna reading is astrological guidance for reflection, not certainty — and not medical, legal or financial advice.

digest.disclaimer: A supportive daily reflection — not fated, and not medical, legal or financial advice.

periodDigest.monthSubtitle: Your month — pravesha chart, dasha & transits
periodDigest.solarMonthHint: The solar month — Maasa Pravesha, the Tajaka monthly solar return (~30.4 days).
periodDigest.lunarMonthHint: The lunar month — your birth tithi returning (~29.5 days). A different window, not just a different chart.
periodDigest.noEvents: No sign-changes or retrograde stations in this window.
periodDigest.sadeSati: Saturn is transiting near your natal Moon — a Sade-Sati phase is active.

bhrigu.title: Bhrigu / Nadi Markers
bhrigu.subtitle: Yearly life markers (traditional predictive aid)
bhrigu.intro: Two classical devices: the Nadi one-sign-per-year progression from the Moon, and the Bhrigu Bindu (the Rahu–Moon midpoint) with its Jupiter/Saturn activations.
bhrigu.progressionIntro: From the natal Moon, the marker sign advances one rasi each year; the natal planets in that sign are what the year activates.
bhrigu.activationsIntro: The next Jupiter & Saturn transits into the Bhrigu Bindu and Moon signs — the turning-point triggers.
bhrigu.noActivations: No activation found in the searched horizon.
bhrigu.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of the coming marker years.
bhrigu.disclaimer: These are indicative traditional markers, not a fated forecast — free will shapes the outcome.

timeline.title: Life Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Dasha periods and transits on one clickable timeline
timeline.intro: Your Vimsottari Mahadasha and Bhukti periods, the Sade Sati / Shani phases, the Jupiter, Saturn and Rahu ingresses, and the eclipses — laid out on a single date axis around today.
timeline.clickHint: Click anywhere on the timeline to read what's running at that point.
timeline.saturnNone: No Sade Sati / Ashtama / Kantaka phase active.
timeline.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of what this period holds.
timeline.disclaimer: This is an indicative reading of the period, not a fated forecast — free will shapes how a period is lived.

conditions.title: Planetary Conditions
conditions.intro: Classical point-conditions that colour how a planet delivers its results but don't show on a plain chart — combustion, vargottama, pushkara, mrityu bhaga, gandanta, planetary war and retrogression.
conditions.none: No special point-conditions stood out — the grahas sit in ordinary dignity.
conditions.hoverHint: Dots mark flagged planets (green = strengthening, red = straining) — hover a planet for details.
conditions.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of what these conditions mean.
conditions.disclaimer: These are classical nuances, not verdicts. "Mrityu bhaga" is a traditional degree, not a statement about lifespan.

avasthas.title: Avasthas (Planetary States)
avasthas.intro: The mood and vitality each graha carries — how ready it is to give its results. Baladi is its age (Yuva/prime is strongest), Jagradadi its wakefulness, Deeptadi its temperament. A nuance that complements raw Shadbala strength.
avasthas.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of the planetary states.
avasthas.disclaimer: Avasthas describe a planet's vitality and mood, not a verdict — read them alongside the rest of the chart.

friendships.title: Planetary Friendships
friendships.intro: Who is whose friend in THIS chart — the compound relationship (natural friendship folded with temporal placement), the house-lord placements that wire the chart together, and any mutual sign exchange (Parivartana).
friendships.matrixNote: Read row → column: how the row planet regards each other planet.
friendships.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of the alliances and house wiring.

strength.title: Planetary Strength
strength.subtitle: Shadbala, Bhava Bala and Vimsopaka — made visible
strength.intro: How capably each planet and house can deliver its results. Strength is not good or bad — a strong malefic simply acts more forcefully.
strength.shadbalaIntro: The overall strength of each graha, ranked. A planet is sufficient when it meets its required rupas (ratio ≥ 1.0).
strength.thresholdNote: The indigo line marks the required strength (ratio 1.0). Green = sufficient, red = below required.
strength.compositionIntro: The six sources that make up each planet's Shadbala, shown as a share of its total.
strength.bhavaIntro: How well-founded each of the twelve houses is, in the order 1–12.
strength.vimsopakaIntro: How consistently each planet holds good dignity across the sixteen divisional charts (out of 20).
strength.vimsopakaNote: Based on the Shodhasavarga (16-varga) scheme; higher is better placed across the vargas.
strength.aiHint: Get a plain-language reading of the strengths and what needs support.
strength.disclaimer: Strength shows capacity to deliver, not whether results are favourable — read it with the rest of the chart.

sadeSati.title: Sade Sati
sadeSati.subtitle: Saturn's transits over your Moon
sadeSati.intro: Sade Sati is the ~7½-year period when Saturn transits the 12th, 1st and 2nd signs from your natal Moon. A time of maturing and consolidation — traditionally testing, but a chapter of growth, not doom.
sadeSati.statusSadeSati: You are in Sade Sati now — the {{phase}} phase, easing around {{end}}.
sadeSati.statusAshtama: Not in Sade Sati, but in Ashtama Shani (Saturn 8th from the Moon) until about {{end}}.
sadeSati.statusKantaka: Not in Sade Sati, but in Kantaka Shani (Saturn 4th from the Moon) until about {{end}}.
sadeSati.statusClear: You are not in Sade Sati, Ashtama or Kantaka Shani right now — Saturn's pressure on the Moon is light.
sadeSati.retroHint: Saturn retrograded back into this sign, so this phase has more than one window.
sadeSati.noSadeSati: No Sade Sati period fell in the scanned window.
sadeSati.otherIntro: Other testing Saturn transits from the Moon — the 8th (Ashtama) and 4th (Kantaka / Ardha-Ashtama).
sadeSati.aiHint: Get a calm, plain-language reading of your Sade Sati and Saturn periods.
sadeSati.disclaimer: Sade Sati is a period of growth and maturing, not a curse — this is indicative guidance, not a prediction of misfortune.

nakshatra.title: Nakshatra Profile
nakshatra.subtitle: Your birth star, its nature & timing
nakshatra.intro: The janma-nakshatra is the star the Moon occupied at your birth — the most personal point in the chart for describing temperament, and the basis of the tarabala day-strength cycle.
nakshatra.calcError: Could not compute the nakshatra profile.
nakshatra.tarabalaIntro: As the Moon circles the 27 stars, each day carries a tara (star-strength) relative to your birth star: favourable days to act, and quieter days to rest.
nakshatra.aiHint: Generate a warm, plain-language profile of your birth star and this month’s favourable days.
nakshatra.disclaimer: A personality-and-timing sketch drawn from classical nakshatra lore — not prediction.

gochara.title: Gochara-phala
gochara.subtitle: Moon-referenced transit results with vedha
gochara.intro: The classical panchang transit reading: each planet’s result is judged by its house counted from the natal Moon. A favourable result can be cancelled by vedha — another planet sitting in a specific obstruction house.
gochara.aiHint: Generate a warm, plain-language reading of how the current transits fall for you.
gochara.disclaimer: Classical gochara guidance — a lens on the current window, not prediction.

journal.title: Astro-Journal
journal.subtitle: Log life events against your dashas
journal.intro: Record dated life events — a job change, a move, a loss, a milestone. Each entry captures the Vimsottari maha/bhukti that was running then, so you (and the AI) can see how your periods actually played out. Entries also help refine your birth time on the rectification page.
